name: MECGEC
description: Driven by the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) has made substantial progress in recent years. However, in Chinese as a Second Language (CSL) domain, existing CGEC datasets rarely incorporate learner-oriented design, i.e. providing correction rationales and more references, which hinders application of LLMs in Chinese language education. To address this gap, this paper introduces the MECGEC , a M ulti-Reference and E xplainable Benchmark for C hinese G rammatical E rror C orrection. MECGEC dataset contains 3,097 instances covering 4 major categories spanning character, word, sentence and punctuation amount to 14 fine-grained subcategories commonly found in authentic CSL learner compositions. In addition, each instance is equipped with multi references and explanation which are generated by LLMs and checked by Chinese language experts sufficiently. Besides, an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs with strong Chinese understanding and reasoning capabilities are carried out based on the MECGEC dataset. With full and enough detailed information of authentic CSL learner errors, the MECGEC can be regarded as a comprehensive CGEC benchmark dataset in CSL domain.
